$comment: First-load JavaScript per page, brotli kB, checked by `node scripts/perf/page-js.mjs --check` in the build job of every merge request pipeline.
The pages are the ten most visited ones (scripts/perf/README.md, 'Page budgets'), with /login as the floor every signed-in page sits on.
The numbers are those of the CI build, which compiles core with no extensions; a production build ships more and is measured the same way with --next-dir.

jsBrotliKb is the budget: measuredKb plus 3 %, rounded up to 5 kB. Room for ordinary growth, not for a new library. measuredKb is the size the budget was last set from (2026-11-16, once the PostHog SDK left the first load, !1525), kept so the next change to a budget shows what it started from.
A change that makes a page legitimately heavier raises its budget in the same merge request, with the before and after numbers in the description.
